# Locally bundled browser libraries

The retirement-statement feature uses these pinned browser builds so it does not need a third-party CDN while the app is running:

- `jspdf.umd.min.js` — jsPDF 2.5.2, MIT License.
- `qrcode-generator.js` — qrcode-generator 1.4.4, MIT License.

Each source file retains its upstream licence notice. Sources: https://github.com/parallax/jsPDF and https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator.
